reader.decision: Approve: implement batching via POST /v2/contacts:batchUpsert with a small Retry-After retry as a safety net. Start with a check of the real per-contact response format before wiring up mark_synced.
reader.decision_reason: The message shows backoff alone leaves throughput at 100 contacts/min (12,000/night), which misses the 30 October deadline. Batching fixes the root cause, and the enterprise tier cannot arrive in time.

reconstruction.problem: Nightly sync sends one PUT per contact with 8 workers (~400 req/min) against a limit of 100 req/min per key. Excess requests get 429 and are skipped. After the Fairhaven import there are 46,800 changed contacts, but the 7200 s deadline allows only ~12,000 contacts per night at 100/min.
reconstruction.what_breaks: Backoff only: throughput stays at 100 contacts/min, so 27 Oct upserted 11,940 and ~34,860 remain pending. The remaining three runs (28, 29, 30 Oct) give 36,000 slots against ~38,280 needed, so the campaign misses its Friday 09:00 UTC deadline. November expos of 40,000 leads would take ~4 nights each.
reconstruction.fix: Add upsert_contacts(batch) in sync/crm_client.py posting to /contacts:batchUpsert, with batches of 100 and a Retry-After sleep on 429 with a small attempt cap. In sync/run_sync.py, rename sync_one to sync_batch, have main chunk contacts by 100, and run mark_synced only for contacts the per-contact response reports as successful. If calls are too close to the limit (96/min at 5 s per call), reduce WORKERS to 6.
reconstruction.cost: One rewrite of the call path. Risks: the per-contact response format is not in docs/juniper-api.md, so success parsing must be checked against a real response; 96 calls/min is near the 100 limit. The enterprise alternative costs 1,450 USD/month with a 3-week lead time, so it misses the deadline.

follow_up_questions: Does Juniper allow batch calls for this API key, or is batchUpsert restricted? The message makes enterprise the fallback only if it is refused.
reader.closing_answer: Implement batching with the Retry-After retry, not backoff only. Verify the batch response format against a real call before relying on it for mark_synced.
